fact: L'Essor reports AGETIC, the state ICT agency, is progressively interconnecting all public and para-public services into the government Intranet, with 13 services integrated in a single-window portal, and managing 13,441 .ml domain names; the document gives no event date, so its published date is used.

At AGETIC's board session the minister set the agency's orientations to reinforce the Guichet unique platform and the administration's intranet and extend it to the new administrative regions, which states AGETIC operates these for the administration.

The ITU framework states AGETIC, a government agency, administers a government data centre with its own specialised cybersecurity team, running its security and a real-time-replicated disaster-recovery site; the document gives no date, so the 2022 publication year is used.

The ITU framework states AGETIC, an agency under the communications and digital ministry, provides hosting services (IaaS, SaaS, backup) to the public administration from its data centre; no date is given, so the 2022 publication year is used.

Mali's SIGRH human resources software was designed and developed by computer specialists of the Malian administration and financed entirely from the national budget, with its database to be hosted in Mali; no contractor is named.
